benchmarks.benchmark_description: SWIT is a construction-safety behavior dataset built from synchronized lower-back IMU measurements and camera-derived pose-estimation trajectories. It covers ten scaffolding behaviors: obstacle, slip, hole, unstable, climb, step-off, squat, kneel, fall-down, and walk (safe). The published benchmark compares sensor-based machine-learning and deep-learning classifiers, pose-estimation-based graph neural networks, and a multimodal ensemble.

benchmarks.benchmark_description: VTT-ConIoT contains wearable IMU data from 13 participants performing 16 construction-related activities using three sensor locations (hip, back, and shoulder).
